-- The customers, from the source rather than the seed's ref('raw_customers').
select
    id as customer_id,
    first_name,
    last_name
from "shop"."main"."raw_customers"

with source as (
    select * from "shop"."main"."raw_orders"
),

renamed as (
    select
        id as order_id,
        customer_id,
        order_date,
        status,
        (amount_cents / 100)::numeric(16, 2) as amount
    from source
)

select * from renamed
select * from "shop"."events"."page_views"

with orders as (
    select * from "shop"."main"."stg_orders"
),

customers as (
    select * from "shop"."main"."stg_customers"
),

final as (
    select
        orders.order_id,
        customers.first_name,
        orders.amount,
        (orders.amount > 0) as is_paid
    from orders
    left join customers using (customer_id)
)

select * from final

select order_id, case when status = 'placed' then amount else 0 end as placed_amount,
  coalesce(status, 'unknown') as status
from "shop"."main"."stg_orders"
select order_id, cast(order_id as varchar) as order_id_text, amount::double as amount_d from "shop"."main"."stg_orders"
select count(*) as n, count(distinct customer_id) as customers from "shop"."main"."stg_orders"
select distinct status from "shop"."main"."stg_orders"
select * exclude (status, amount) from "shop"."main"."stg_orders"

select customer_id, count(*) as n, max(order_date) as last_order
from "shop"."main"."stg_orders"
where status <> 'returned'
group by customer_id
having sum(amount) > 0
select customer_id, status, sum(amount) as total, count(*) as n from "shop"."main"."stg_orders" group by all

select first_name from "shop"."main"."stg_customers"
where customer_id in (select customer_id from "shop"."main"."stg_orders" where status = 'placed')
select order_id from "shop"."main"."stg_orders" order by amount desc limit 3
select customer_id, string_agg(status, ',' order by order_date) as statuses from "shop"."main"."stg_orders" group by customer_id
select 1 as one, current_date as today from "shop"."main"."stg_orders"

select coalesce(amount, 0) + 1 as amount_plus, greatest(order_id, customer_id) as g, nullif(status, '') as s,
  min(amount) over (partition by customer_id) as min_amount
from "shop"."main"."stg_orders"
select order_id from "shop"."main"."stg_orders" order by amount desc

select order_id, customer_id from "shop"."main"."stg_orders"
qualify row_number() over (partition by customer_id order by order_date desc) = 1
select status from "shop"."main"."stg_orders" where status = 'placed'
select o.*, c.first_name from "shop"."main"."stg_orders" o join "shop"."main"."stg_customers" c on o.customer_id = c.customer_id

select c.customer_id,
  (select max(o.amount) from "shop"."main"."stg_orders" o where o.customer_id = c.customer_id and o.status = 'placed') as max_placed
from "shop"."main"."stg_customers" c

select order_id as id, 'order' as kind from "shop"."main"."stg_orders"
union all
select customer_id as id, 'customer' as kind from "shop"."main"."stg_customers"
select * from "shop"."main"."stg_orders" o full join "shop"."main"."stg_customers" c using (customer_id)
select o.*, c.first_name from "shop"."main"."stg_orders" o join "shop"."main"."stg_customers" c using (customer_id)
select customer_id, o.status from "shop"."main"."stg_orders" o left join "shop"."main"."stg_customers" c using (customer_id)
select o.* from "shop"."main"."stg_orders" o left join "shop"."main"."stg_customers" c using (customer_id)
select * from "shop"."main"."stg_orders" o left join "shop"."main"."stg_customers" c using (customer_id)
select * from "shop"."main"."stg_orders" o join "shop"."main"."stg_customers" c using (customer_id)

select order_id, row_number() over (partition by customer_id order by order_date) as rn,
  sum(amount) over (partition by customer_id) as customer_total
from "shop"."main"."stg_orders"
select * from "shop"."main"."stg_orders"

with customer_orders as (
    select customer_id, count(*) as order_count
    from "shop"."main"."orders"
    group by customer_id
)

select stg.*, customer_orders.order_count
from "shop"."main"."stg_customers" as stg
left join customer_orders using (customer_id)

-- Its upstream is a variable: only dbt knows it.
select count(*) as orders from "shop"."main"."orders"
